name: CA PIPEDA Personal Information
description: A Canadian identifier (SIN, health card, passport or driver's licence) with a name or date-of-birth label.
expression: (((D:CA-SIN > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-Card-ON > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-Card-QC > 0) OR (D:CA-Health-Card-BC > 0) OR (D:CA-Passport > 0) OR (D:CA-Drivers-Licence-ON > 0) OR (D:CA-Drivers-Licence-QC > 0)) AND (D:CA-Privacy-Name-DOB-Keywords > 0))

name: CA Provincial Health Information
description: A provincial health card number (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia) with health information terms (PHIPA, Quebec Law 25 health).

name: CA Identifier Bulk
description: Five or more Canadian identifiers of one kind in one document (a list or export), no name label needed.
expression: ((D:CA-SIN > 4) OR (D:CA-Health-Card-ON > 4) OR (D:CA-Health-Card-QC > 4) OR (D:CA-Health-Card-BC > 4) OR (D:CA-Passport > 4) OR (D:CA-Drivers-Licence-ON > 4) OR (D:CA-Drivers-Licence-QC > 4))

name: CA Bank Account Low Confidence
description: LOW CONFIDENCE: a transit or institution number with an account number, each beside its label. Expect false positives; review before enabling.
